name: camera-barcode-scanner
title: Camera Barcode Scanner
description: Scan barcodes and QR codes with your Mac or iPhone camera and type each one into the app in front, like a USB scanner.
author: daanmlab

commands.name: toggle-barcode-scanner
commands.title: Toggle Barcode Scanner
commands.subtitle: Camera Barcode Scanner
commands.description: Start the scanner window. Run again to stop it. Each code is typed into the app in front.

commands.name: scan-barcode-once
commands.title: Scan Barcode Once
commands.subtitle: Camera Barcode Scanner
commands.description: Open the scanner window, type the first code it reads, and close.

preferences.name: suffix
preferences.title: After Each Code
preferences.description: Key to press after each code.

preferences.name: gsSeparator
preferences.title: GS1 Group Separator
preferences.description: GS1 codes can hold a hidden separator character (ASCII 29). Most apps cannot show it.

preferences.name: gsReplacement
preferences.title: Separator Replacement
preferences.description: Text typed for the separator when you choose Replace.

preferences.name: camera
preferences.title: Camera
preferences.description: Which camera to use. Automatic picks a nearby iPhone first, then the built-in camera.

preferences.name: dedupeSeconds
preferences.title: Ignore Repeats For
preferences.description: After a read, the same code is ignored for this long.

preferences.name: codesQr
preferences.title: Code Types
preferences.label: QR Codes
preferences.description: Read QR and Micro QR codes.

preferences.name: codesDataMatrix
preferences.label: Data Matrix
preferences.description: Read Data Matrix codes, common on medicine and parts.

preferences.name: codesAztec
preferences.label: Aztec
preferences.description: Read Aztec codes, common on tickets and boarding passes.

preferences.name: codesPdf417
preferences.label: PDF417
preferences.description: Read PDF417 and Micro PDF417 codes, common on ID cards.

preferences.name: codes1d
preferences.label: 1D Barcodes
preferences.description: Read line barcodes: Code 128, Code 39, Code 93, EAN, UPC-E, ITF-14, Interleaved 2 of 5 and Codabar.

preferences.name: codesGs1DataBar
preferences.label: GS1 DataBar
preferences.description: Read GS1 DataBar codes, common on fresh food.
